title: Authorized pooler pool() transaction sandwichable without private mempool
description: The authorized pooler's pool(minBPT) transaction, when submitted through a public mempool, is visible to MEV bots who can sandwich it. The H-02 fix correctly transfers sandwich protection responsibility to the authorized pooler (who sets minBPT), but the single-sided UNBALANCED liquidity add is inherently more susceptible to price manipulation than proportional adds. With large accumulated sUSDS balances (many dispatches between pool calls), extractable value increases.
impact: Protocol receives fewer BPT than fair value if pooler uses public mempool with insufficient minBPT.
recommendation: Authorized poolers MUST use private mempools (e.g., Flashbots Protect). Consider adding an owner-settable minimum floor for minBPT that prevents any pooler from passing a value below it.
